newsitem.title: USA: Kinetiks.com Inc CEO steps aside.
newsitem.headline: Kinetiks.com Inc CEO steps aside.

text.p: Kinetiks.com Inc said on Friday that Gregory Carr has decided to resign as chief executive officer and step into a role to lead the company's corporate development efforts.
In this position, he will be able to focus on moving the company more rapidly ahead in the Internet content-commerce and software development market, the company said.
The company has initiated a search for a new CEO while the board of directors continues an active role in managing the financial side of the business during reorganization, the company said.

In another move to restructure the company, co-founders Greg and Dyann Carr have elected to retire 3 million shares of common stock owned by them, bringing total 1996 stock retirement to 3.45 million shares, the company said.
Of those, 1 million shares will be transferred to the board with voting rights and be subject to retirement at board discretion within six to 12 months, the company said.
